reviews.intro: Real reviews from customers on Which? Trusted Traders.

items.text: Simon and his team arrived early, all of them were lovely. Cut down 2 conifers and cleared everything and kept the area clean. I would recommend them very highly. I have them coming back later in the year to prune another big tree for me.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Simon and his team came when promised to fell to ground level a dead acacia tree in our back garden and grind out the stump. They did the job professionally with all the right safety equipment, avoided damaging nearby trees and shrubs, removed the remains of the tree and left the garden very tidy. …
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Simon and his team were very polite and did a great job at trimming down a large hedge at the side of our house and pruning back a large lilac tree in our garden. We were very pleased with the work done, and how well they tidied up afterwards. We will definitely be using them again in the future.
items.label: Which? review

faqs.a: Yes. Burnley's Tree Services is a Which? Trusted Trader, and you can read all our customer reviews on our Which? page.
Yes. We are qualified and insured to carry out all aspects of tree surgery, and all our work is carried out to BS3998 industry standards.
We are based in North Hertfordshire but cover a large area including Bedfordshire, North London, and surrounding areas.
